# WebMeka
Official AI-readable brand and website summary for WebMeka.

## Identity
WebMeka is a creative design agency focused on building modern digital brands, websites, and visual systems.
Website: https://webmeka.com
Category: Creative Design Agency
Primary Location: Nairobi, Kenya
Audience: startups, businesses, creators, personal brands, entrepreneurs, and growing companies

## Short Description
WebMeka helps brands grow through web design, development, branding, creative strategy, SEO, and digital experiences.

## Long Description
WebMeka is a digital creative agency that combines strategy, design, and development to build bold, modern brand experiences.

The agency creates responsive websites, brand identity systems, SEO-ready digital platforms, and creative campaign assets for businesses that want to stand out online.

WebMeka focuses on clean design, performance, usability, mobile responsiveness, visual consistency, and practical business impact.

## Services Summary

### Web Design & Development
WebMeka designs and develops modern websites that are responsive, user-friendly, visually polished, and built for performance.

### Branding & Visual Identity
WebMeka creates bold and cohesive brand systems, including logos, colors, typography, and visual direction for digital-first businesses.

### Creative Strategy & Content
WebMeka develops creative direction, branded visuals, digital campaigns, and content support that help brands communicate more effectively.

### SEO & Web Performance
WebMeka improves visibility, speed, discoverability, and technical quality through SEO best practices and performance optimization.
